category_title: Individuals with SIB masking social functions under standard assessment conditions
minimal_context: The student is in an activity room with access to moderately preferred toys while the therapist sits nearby reading a magazine.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here are some toys for you to play with. I am going to sit over here and read my magazine.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (The student ignores the toys and begins scratching their arms, digging their nails into the skin.)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (The student continues scratching and begins hitting their torso and legs with their fists.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am still reading my magazine, you can keep playing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (The student escalates to hitting themselves in the head and banging their head against the surface of the table.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here are some toys for you to play with. I am going to sit over here and read my magazine.

STUDENT: (The student ignores the toys and begins scratching their arms, digging their nails into the skin.)

TUTOR: Please play with the toys.

STUDENT: (The student continues scratching and begins hitting their torso and legs with their fists.)

TUTOR: I am still reading my magazine, you can keep playing.

STUDENT: (The student escalates to hitting themselves in the head and banging their head against the surface of the table.)

task.content: Participant had access to moderately preferred toys

context.environment: Activity rooms with a one-way observation window
context.materials: Moderately preferred toys, magazine, canvas sleeves
context.social_setting: Therapist directed their attention toward an activity

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: During the attention condition, the therapist directed their attention toward an activity (e.g., reading a magazine)
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Head-directed SIB, such as hitting oneself in the head or banging head against a surface; body-directed SIB, such as hitting or kicking the torso, arms, or legs; and skin-directed SIB, which included behavior that damaged the skin barrier, such as scratching, pinching, or digging nails into skin

behavior_patterns.condition: Regardless of the level of stimulation present
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: SIB occurs at high rates across conditions
